notes.title: New "Retro" Level Set Comes With A Major New Update
notes.notes:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30056096/6c796bab22df9553b01c9c8830552c305b218cf5.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30056096/9df5d1c7cd2cebb81e2c1d17617379d8f2dbc3d8.png[/img][/url] [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30056096/228bb6d8daf1c36bcf5d6422f8651834a0366cb3.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30056096/009328daaef2ab51e2a893657c7e13b255b8831e.png[/img][/url]
This is a big one!! Many big improvements have been made to the engine that drives the game to create a smoother and more responsive experience. Lots of polishing of graphics and tweaks to the gameplay. A new hard difficulty level. And at last, a whooping 100+ levels added in a new "Retro" level set.

Here is a list of the main changes:
[list]
[*] New Retro level set
[*] Hard difficulty level added
[*] Faster, smoother game engine
[*] Various tweaks and bug fixes
[*] All control methods vastly improved
[*] Added game controller deadzone option
[*] Helper bot hp halved
[*] Better gem brick clarity
[*] Better spacing of the status bar
[*] Player shrapnel is now harmful, much like the original game
[*] Tips moved to end of level stats screen
[*] Added a minute to time limit
[*] New brick designs
[/list]

notes.title: This Update Brings Multiplayer Saves!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30056096/526c89cce7cb8145d8b103648a1fd816cd37dcdd.png[/img]
This is a biggie! I've been putting off making multiplayer mode save progress because I knew how much work was involved, which included changing a lot of core code which affected almost everything. But pleasing my users is top priority - so many hours later here it is. This is a full list of what's new in version 1.15: 
[list]
[*] Multiplayer progress is now saved
[*] Improved game controller rumble effects, with option to turn off
[*] Vastly improved game controller analogue controls
[*] Better player physics
[*] Various tweaks to user interface
[*] Lower shop prices in easy level mode
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.07 includes visual improvements, modding capability and much more
notes.notes:
Lots of internal changes to the game engine.
Now using SDL 2.0.7 and SDL_mixer 2.0.2.
New MOD capabilities added for creating community (Workshop) content.
New menu options for nerds, including technical game-engine stats.
Removed analogue joystick option (it never worked very well).
User levels are now saved in user directory (with save game).
Improved high score table visuals.
Fixed touch for tablet PCs.
Various visual improvements to menus.
More sound effects added.
